title: RAW_UNSCREENED: ofchy als Registerhomonym oder Stoffname
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: exact ofchy occurs at f22r.4, f26v.5 and f39v.1 in Herbal contexts; one whole-form meaning may be a material head, while a register-local field use predicts a distinct role.

design.scope_description: Three reader-exact ofchy loci and neighboring complete fields from GDT765.
design.mechanism: Register-local homography permits one form to name a material in content slots and mark a quality/index field in a different record frame.
design.unit: ofchy daiin; ofchy chs ar; ofchy kar or aiin.
design.contrast: Portable material noun versus register-local quality/index function.
design.prediction: Material reading predicts compatible material cofields at all three loci; homography predicts the two non-value frames behave as a distinct field role while f22r.4 remains a content/value cell.
concrete_observations: GDT765 reports exact spans at f22r.4, f26v.5 and f39v.1.
Only f22r.4 is an exact X+daiin value cell; the other two have different neighboring frames.
linked_consequences: A portable noun should survive the frame change without changing referent type.
A homographic field should predict frame-specific neighbors and not export the f22r value interpretation.
design.nearest_rival: One stable whole-form material name used in all frames.
design.distinguishing_observation: Compare frame-conditioned cofields with target-independent controls; a role switch must recur in the same register pattern, not be assigned ad hoc per occurrence.
design.strongest_likely_failure: Three loci are sparse and the frame difference may simply reflect ordinary noun placement.
